SECONDAMENDMENTTO ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT SECONDAMENDMENTTOZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT,iS effective as of the _ day of Sepember, 2015 by and between Peter Weiss and Miriam Weiss, residing at 1284 East 19" Street, Brooklyn, New York 11230 (collectively, "Weiss"), and 1288 Plaza LLC, having an address at c/o Abeco, 6701 Bay Parkway, Brooklyn, New York 11204 ("1288;” and together with Weiss, sometimes hereinafter collectively referred to as the "Parties"). WITNESSETH WHEREAS, on or about March 2, 2006, East 19"h Street Condos LLC and Weiss executed a Zoning Lot Development Agreement (the “ZLDA") as annexed hereto as Exhibit "A", affecting Development Land, the Conveyed Land and First Land and which amended the terms of the Restrictive Covenant, as said terms are defined in the ZLDA; and WHEREAS, 1288 is successor in interest to East 19"h Street Condos LLC; WHEREAS,on April 30, 2013, 1288 and Weiss executed an Amendment to Zoning Lot Development Agreement (the “First Amendment") as annexed hereto as Exhibit “B", affecting Sections 5 and 6 of the ZLDA, and providing the terms for 1288's access to and use of Weiss' electrical power; and WHEREAS, the Parties desire to further amend some of the terms of the ZLDA and First Amendment as specifically set forth herein; and NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the foregoing, the mutual covenants contained herein, and other valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which is acknowledged by the Parties, the Parties hereto hereby agree to amend the ZLDA and First Amendment, as follows: 1. All of the WHEREAS Clauses above are hereby incorporated herein by reference as if set forth herein at length. In addition, all capitalized terms shall, if not defined herein, have the meaning as set forth in the ZLDA. 2. The Parties agree that paragraphs 5(B), (C), (D), and (E) of the ZLDA, together with any Schedules referenced in any of the aforementioned paragraphs, and paragraphs 3, 5 and Exhibit B to the First Amendment are deleted in their entirety.  3.Weiss expressly acknowledges and agrees that the current footprint of the New Building as shown on the survey annexed hereto as Exhibit “C" that is being constructed on the Development Land, Development Property, Conveyed Land, and Restricted Premises including, without limitation, the steel shown on Exhibit “C" does not violate, and will not be construed hereafter as violating the Restrictive Covenant, or any provision of the ZLDA, the First Amendment or this Agreement.
